## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (68%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
OOD 100th percentile; Invasive in the 90% set [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 68%, Invasive 32% | Leading, not decisive |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / 100th percentile | Flagged; atypical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 2, 6, 11) · context · 91% tumor nuclei; top of reference set [F7] · Measured
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; concept model leans less invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Benign stroma/fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low benign-stroma score; concept model leans invasive · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 3, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; concept model leans less invasive · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60): faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable here: normal lobules (0/20), the largest term.

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical image (OOD 100th percentile) distorts probabilities.
- Focal invasion exists: region 11 scores 50% invasive risk; second model disagrees.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11** Highest invasive risk (50%); look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 6, 8** Check atypical cells are duct-confined with intact myoepithelium.
3. **Region 2** Tumor-infiltrating stroma peaks here; confirm or exclude invasion.
